papers.whyItMatters: Sources the driver-efficiency term eta_D of the ICF side of the Q ledger as a requirement. Paired with the Mercury demonstration (4.6% electrical-to-optical at 33.4 J, a separate LLNL source), it shows the gap between required and demonstrated driver efficiency.
papers.limitation: A requirement and a review, not a demonstrated plant eta_D. The ≥70% figure is diode electrical-to-optical, not driver wall-plug. Binds S-Q, which is CUT as an output; ledger input only. No version bump.

papers.title: NRL Plasma Formulary (2007 edition)
papers.venue: Naval Research Laboratory, Beam Physics Branch, Plasma Physics Division, Washington, DC (2007 edition)
papers.coreIdea: The standard plasma-physics formulary. Page 28 gives the electron collision rate nu_e = 2.91e-6 n_e lnΛ T_e^-3/2 s^-1 and the ion collision rate nu_i = 4.80e-8 Z^4 mu^-1/2 n_i lnΛ T_i^-3/2 s^-1 (n in cm^-3, T in eV); the ion–ion Coulomb logarithm is on page 34.
papers.whyItMatters: Sets the collision time that the Layer 1 coherence target (decoherence time above 1e-9 s) has to beat. At n_i = 1e20 cm^-3 and T_i = 1 keV the ion collision time is of order a nanosecond or less, so 'maintained phase coherence' between colliding pairs has no margin.
papers.limitation: Textbook formulas with order-unity coefficients; the result depends on the Coulomb logarithm chosen. The edition consulted is 2007 (an earlier candidate said 2013). Government reference, not a journal (A5 fails). Moves no C. No version bump.

papers.title: Diagnostic Methodologies of Laser-Initiated 11B(p,α)2α Fusion Reactions
papers.coreIdea: Review of diagnostics for laser-initiated p-11B fusion. p + 11B → 3α + 8.7 MeV proceeds mainly via 8Be: through the 8Be ground state (alpha_0 + 8Be, channel Q = 8.59 MeV; 8Be → 2α with Q = 91.8 keV) or through 8Be* (alpha_1 channel Q = 5.65 MeV, width 1.5 MeV; 8Be* → 2α with Q = 3.028 MeV). In laser plasmas alpha_0 and alpha_1 are estimated at about 5.7 and 3.76 MeV; the secondary alphas spread from 0 to above 5 MeV.
papers.whyItMatters: Corrects the Layer 3 alpha-energy premise: 8.7 MeV is shared by three alphas, so no single alpha carries '2.9 to 8.7 MeV'. The alpha spectrum is the input for any phase-space repopulation or direct-conversion term.
papers.limitation: Diagnostics review with channel energies from kinematics, not a new nuclear-data measurement. Laser-driven, not a thermal burn. 91.8 keV is the 8Be ground-state decay Q, not the primary fusion Q. Moves no C. No version bump.

papers.title: Experimental and computational results on direct energy conversion for mirror fusion reactors
papers.coreIdea: A 22-stage electrostatic periodic-focusing direct converter, fed by a hydrogen plasma source through a magnetic expander, recovered 86.5 ± 1.5% of the beam energy at low beam density, against a predicted 88.6 ± 1.5%. Efficiency fell as space charge rose, and the authors judged the scheme probably economical only for mean ion energies above about 500 keV.
papers.whyItMatters: The best measured electrostatic DEC number. It bounds the manuscript's 'DEC > 90%' for Layer 4: lab beams reach about 86.5%, not above 90%.
papers.limitation: Low-density hydrogen beam test, not reactor plasma and not MeV p-11B alphas (G4 fails as support). Usable as a bound, not as evidence for S-L4. Moves no C. No version bump. Separate entry from Barr & Moir 1983 (different converter, experiment and DOI).

papers.title: Test Results on Plasma Direct Converters
papers.coreIdea: A single-stage plasma direct converter on the end wall of the Tandem Mirror Experiment (TMX). Of 138 W incident, 79 W were recovered and 12 W powered the suppressor grid, a net efficiency of 48%, in agreement with the calculated 47%.

papers.title: Neutron Yield from p11B Fusion Plasma
papers.coreIdea: Estimates the neutron yield of a p-11B plasma from its side reactions: 2.27e-3 neutrons per fusion reaction (mean 2.49 MeV) at T_i = 300 keV and T_i/T_e = 1, and 9.62e-5 (mean 3.93 MeV) at T_i/T_e = 200. 11B(p,n)11C and 11B(α,n)14N dominate; (γ,n) in stainless structure and 11B(d,n)12C on deuterium impurity complete the four main channels; the rest are below 1e-7.
papers.whyItMatters: Puts a number on 'nearly aneutronic': about 0.2% neutrons per reaction at equal temperatures. Contradicts the manuscript's 'fully aneutronic' premise for Layer 4 and the shielding-free plant it implies.
papers.limitation: Body in Japanese; the numbers are from the author's English abstract (not machine-translated). Calculation, not a measurement. Moves no C. No version bump.

papers.limitation: No neutron percentage in the opened text; qualitative only. Moves no C. No version bump.
